Name: Fireworks
Script:
// Fireworks - the Scenes engine functional test.
// Rockets launch from the bottom, arc under gravity, and burst at their apex
// into colored shells; some shell sparks spawn a few trailing embers.
@scene fps=30 bg=#000010 trail=0.86 size=32x48

emit rockets
  rate    = 1 per 0.45..0.95s
  origin  = x:rand y:bottom
  vel     = dir:up speed:34..44
  gravity = down 22
  color   = pick(#ffd27f,#ffb24d,#fff2c2)
  life    = 3s
  die     = when vy<=0
  spawn   = burst

emit burst
  count   = 60..110 burst
  origin  = parent
  vel     = dir:radial speed:14..30
  gravity = down 16
  color   = pick(#ff4d4d,#ffd24d,#4dff6a,#4da6ff,#c44dff,#ffffff)
  fade    = 1.3s
  spawn   = embers @0.35

emit embers
  count   = 1..3 burst
  origin  = parent
  vel     = dir:radial speed:3..8
  gravity = down 16
  color   = parent
  fade    = 0.7s
